title: Hatred Stems from Ignorance! Distillation of the Persuasion Modes in Countering Conversational Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying hate speech and evaluating persuasion modes (reason, emotion, credibility) as well as power dynamics in human-authored and machine-generated counterspeech addressing racism.
